name: OCaml
description: A functional programming language with an emphasis on expressiveness and safety.
summary: AI-assisted contributions are judged on merit. Contributors must have written or reviewed every part, take responsibility for provenance, and disclose significant AI-generated code, PR descriptions or comments with the tool used. Bug reports should contain only human-verified information, with any LLM content clearly separated.

evidence.quote: We ask that you have either written, or read and reviewed yourself, every part of your contribution. You are responsible for its quality.
When you submit code, however it was written, you take responsibility for its provenance.
If a significant portion of your code, PR description, review comments or messages has been AI-generated, this must be disclosed, stating which tool was used and for what.
a bug report should be to the point and contain only human-verified information.
Moreover, mixing human and LLM-generated contents in the same report without a clear separation should be imperatively avoided.
